## Summary

Allow reviewed caller configuration to repair an already merged commit message using its PR number and exact Git SHA. A repair can supply a conventional documentation subject or wrap an overlong body. Capture preserves the original message, validates the corrected message, checks that breaking notes are unchanged, and records a warning.

## Verification

- Snapshot regression tests cover both errors from Upkeep's release cycle, deterministic replay, retained raw evidence, and rejection of unrelated repairs.
- Proposal verification checks that each repair in a captured proposal remains explicitly authorized by the current configuration.
- [Upkeep rolling release failure](https://github.com/lhajoosten/upkeep-bot/actions/runs/44842041576)

- The full repository check passed in the commit hook. A read-only replay against real Upkeep Git and GitHub evidence verified the v0.2.0 proposal and returned `no-release`.

## Merge Danger

Two-way. The repair applies to individually pinned commits during capture. Ordinary PR metadata validation still checks the original message before merge.

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Allow exact, reviewed message repairs for commits that have already merged.
impact: Recover a blocked release cycle while preserving the original Git evidence.
required_action: null
```
